_notes: Sensirion STCC4 miniature CO2 sensor (paired with SHT41 for RH/T compensation), fixed address 0x64. Detection is empty (unique address) - the product-ID command cannot be used because the detection path issues a single write+read with no inter-command delay and the STCC4 NACKs that read - so the record claims any device at 0x64. Init: start_continuous_measurement (0x218B). Poll: read_measurement (0xEC05), 1 ms pause, read 12 bytes = CO2/temp/humidity/status words each followed by a CRC byte (skipped via 'at'). CO2 raw = ppm; temperature = -45 + 175*s/65535; humidity = -6 + 125*s/65535. Must never be probed by the RSAO delegated-identification hook (its framed 0x99 command stops the sensor measuring); RaftI2C DeviceIdentMgr only runs that hook when no device-type record matches - this record's empty detection always matches, so the hook is never reached at 0x64. See devdocs/stcc4-identification-notes.md
